name: tmp-idle-wake-probe
description: RETIRED DIAGNOSTIC, excluded from `all` via wip. A the earlier probe whose gate 1 is DESIGNED to fail - the failure is how it reports its answer - so it can never be green and does not belong in a pass/fail suite. Seven stored runs, 1 passed / 2 failed in every one, including 2026-07-27. Still runnable by name. The idle behaviour it was asking about is now guarded by idle-survival. ORIGINAL NOTE: The earlier confirmation probe: does the space-activation settle completion need an external runloop wake? Scroll, then go completely quiet and wait 60s for the activation. If it does not land, send a single no-op cursor move and wait again briefly. Gate 1 failing while gate 2 passes confirms the wake dependency and makes the bug deterministic.

actions.note: GATE 1: 60s of total quiet - no further input of any kind
the wake: a single cursor move, which mutates no app state
GATE 2: if this passes after gate 1 failed, the activation was pending and the cursor move released it
